method: Viewed all eight J, all eight Y/H and leading VIS preview panels, each independently contrast-stretched to 1st–99.5th percentile. Source at WCS cutout centre. Visual morphology is qualitative, not a flux or PSF analysis.
provenance: output/image_pixel_receipts.json; 32 original MER FITS science 251x251 pixel sections, S3 byte-range reads; per-image science SHA256 and preview PNG SHA256 in receipts
known_limitations: Background in preview stretched independently per band; brightness comparison across bands is invalid
MER mosaics do not resolve single-exposure persistence/ghost histories
Image thumbnails do not supply bit masks, source segmentation, PSF-fitting, or forced optical/WISE fluxes
A visual risk flag is not proof a source is astrophysical or spurious
